scope_manifest.design_scope: all existing 44 App screens and Website content families, approved surface variants and task interaction prototypes

constraints: existing Experience Constitution and ScreenSpecs remain authoritative
reuse authorized Figma file first; create necessary file when no reusable file is accessible
real editable file/node/version readback; no screenshot or fake .fig substitution
no new paid resource, public publication or credential access
local dependency affects only its path; M standby does not pause workers
rule publication is not completed design or product acceptance
